comment: Provenance for every package in forks/. bin/pi-setup-doctor reads this to report upstream drift; bin/pi-setup-vendor reads it to re-vendor a fork onto a newer upstream release. An entry with upstream:null is first-party and has neither.

pi-dynamic-workflows-safe.note: extensions/workflow/index.ts imports ../../src/*.js, so src/ is the tree Pi loads. dist/ is a compiled mirror reachable only through the package exports field; rebuild it with npm run build.

pi-process-monitor-safe.note: Hand-written rewrite rather than a patch of upstream, imported into this repository with its original commit history. Not re-vendorable with bin/pi-setup-vendor.

pi-context-handoff.note: First-party extension, not a fork: replaces pi-continue. Steers Pi's own compaction and cannot abort a turn. No upstream to track and nothing to re-vendor.
